title: Deliver Wood to Chudworth Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Chudworth Sawmill** (industry id 2, near tile 84,24).

A likely supplier is **Suntburg Forest** (industry id 3, near tile 95,7); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **300 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
